description.narrative: Building on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Fund, the Joint SDG Fund is an inter-agency mechanism for strategic financing and integrated policy support. The Fund backs United Nations efforts across all 17 Sustainable Development Goals and cross-cutting areas so programme countries can accelerate SDG progress on the path to 2030 Agenda achievement.
